description: This file provides functions and types for managing Windows installation root directories, including registry querying, environment variable handling, and path normalization.

classes.name: WindowsInstallRoots
classes.description: Type representing Windows installation root directories including system root, Program Files, and Program Files (x86).

methods.name: normalizeWindowsInstallRoot
methods.description: Normalizes and validates raw Windows path strings to ensure they are absolute, local directories.

methods.name: getWindowsInstallRoots
methods.description: Retrieves Windows installation root directories, optionally using registry data and caching results.

methods.name: getWindowsProgramFilesRoots
methods.description: Returns an array of Windows Program Files directories, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: _resetWindowsInstallRootsForTests
methods.description: Resets internal cached data and allows overriding functions for testing purposes.
